documents.title: Using Generative AI at Colby College - A Legal Perspective (guidance memorandum)
documents.stance_why: The memo says its considerations 'should not discourage you from exploring and using artificial intelligence' and calls generative AI 'a powerful tool', while setting conditions: use College-approved platforms, verify output, disclose AI involvement, and avoid AI for critical decisions. It sets no per-course rule and does not hand the choice to instructors, so it is permit with conditions.
documents.summary: A legal-risk memo from the General Counsel to all Colby users of generative AI. It covers privacy, hiring bias, hallucination, IP, antitrust and cybercrime, then lists guidelines such as verifying output, disclosing AI use and not using AI for critical decisions. It sets no course-level academic rules and points to the Davis Institute, CTL and Provost for teaching questions.
